newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ top dressing plane crashes, pilot hurt.
newsitem.headline: NZ top dressing plane crashes, pilot hurt.

text.p: The pilot of a Fletcher topdressing plane is in a serious condition in Palmerston North hospital after his aircraft crashed east of Dannevirke on Tuesday, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
The accident happened in remote hill country at Awariki, 13 km east of Dannevirke, about 9.45 a.m.
Dannevirke police were not releasing the injured man's name this afternoon. It was understood he has extensive back and leg injuries. Relatives were yet to be notified.
NZPA said the aircraft was operated by Eastland Contracts, of Dannevirke, and was spreading fertiliser from a nearby airstrip at the time of the crash.
